messages:
anya: Heads-up — Gatekeeper (payments) asked about a CompetitorX -> Redwood migration POC. They care about prompt parity, response deltas, and a clean pricing comparison. Can @matt and @raj help scope the presales checklist?

matt: Yep. Key things we should validate in the POC: input/output shape parity, rate-limit behavior, streaming vs non-streaming differences, and any tokenization deltas that change completion length.

raj: I can own the test harness. Will create a small proxy shim that can switch between CompetitorX and Redwood for the same prompt set. Quick Q: do we have a canonical prompt pack for payments vertical or should I reuse the generic "auth & disputes" set?

anya: Use the auth & disputes pack + 20 production prompts Gatekeeper gave. They want side-by-side diffs.

matt: For parity, recommend: 1) response normalization layer (strip timing noise, optional stop tokens), 2) retry/fallback mapping for 429 -> backoff, 3) deterministic sampling settings if they require. Example mapping snippet I’ll push to the repo: 
```
# header mapping for proxy
X-Client-Id -> x-client-id
Accept: text/event-stream -> Accept: application/json (when switching streaming off)
```

raj: Perfect. I'll wire that. Also need clarity on billing: Gatekeeper asked whether token counting differs vs CompetitorX (they've got a fixed bundle). We should produce a side-by-side cost estimate for expected QPS and average tokens per session.

matt: I'll run some microbenchmarks to get per-token latencies and tokenized lengths for their prompts on the selected Redwood model. That feeds into cost estimate.

katie: On infra/security: they require VPC egress IPs for allowlisting and an SOC2 attestation. For a POC we can offer a temporary static egress pool from Dedicated staging, but need 48h lead time to reserve. Also confirm TLS mutual auth? Gatekeeper's infra team mentioned client certs.

anya: They did ask for cert-based mutual TLS for server->client callbacks. Is that supported in the private deployment only?

katie: mTLS for callbacks currently only available on Private with VPN/VPC. Hosted can do TLS + OAuth, but not client certs. I'll detail options in the checklist.

olivia: On security questionnaire items I saw: data residency, shared log retention, KMS key ownership, and breach notification timelines. We can answer: SOC2 Type II, support customer-managed KMS for Private, hosted stores keys in HSM (we need to provide the exact doc link). For PII handling — we need to confirm whether Gatekeeper will send PANs in prompts; that affects scope.

anya: I'll ask Gatekeeper to redact or use tokenized references for PANs during POC, but they want to test with synthetic but realistic data.

raj: For the POC timeline: recommended 2-week technical run: week 1 parity tests and latency/cost benchmarks; week 2 integration and security signoffs. Then a 30-min sync demo. Is that OK?

matt: Sounds good. Also flagging one blocker we found earlier with CompetitorX: some prompts depend on subtle tokenization quirks that change stop-token placement. We'll run a diff and include a few suggested prompt rewrites to preserve behavior.

katie: Operational checklist I need: list of IPs to allowlist, contact for their infra, whether they want Dedicated staging or Private evaluation, and SLA expectations (we can offer 99.9% for Dedicated).

anya: Gatekeeper rep is "calvin@gatekeeper.co" and infra lead is "maria@gatekeeper.co". I'll confirm Dedicated staging for the POC. SLA can be TBD for POC.

olivia: I'll draft short answers to the security questionnaire and flag anything requiring legal review (customer-managed KMS + export control language).

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline report: staging pool request ticket created #STG-4821 — ETA 48h.

raj: Great — action items: (1) matt: run tokenization & latency microbenchmarks, (2) raj: build shim + alignment harness, (3) katie: reserve staging egress IPs and confirm mTLS limitations, (4) olivia: draft sec questionnaire answers, (5) anya: ask Gatekeeper for synthetic PAN dataset and confirm Dedicated staging. I'll open a GH repo and share test vectors.

anya: Thanks everyone — I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow at 10am PT and share the GH link. :thumbsup:

matt: On it. Will post initial benchmark numbers by EOD.

olivia: Will circulate questionnaire answers in the thread when ready.

katie: I'll post the IPs and staging config once ticket moves.

anya: Closing — next update in this thread after benchmarks.
